title: TurnComplete
description: Payload of the terminal SSE `complete` event from POST /api/turn (docs/005 §5.5). Carries the persisted message ids so the UI can flip its optimistic placeholders onto the backend-assigned rows and re-anchor the per-turn cost counter.

user_message_id.description: Id of the persisted user `messages` row for this turn.

assistant_message_id.description: Id of the persisted assistant `messages` row for this turn.
